Applying for Graduate Admission
Are you applying to a Doctoral, Master's or Certificate Program?
Create an account to start a new application.
NOTE: Some UToledo programs require a National Centralized Application (CAS), not
the UToledo application. See below.
Already started an application or Need to submit a new application?
Log into an existing account.
Applying for a combined bachelor's/master's program?
Combined Bachelor's/Master's Program Application
Must be a current student with a Rocket ID.Â
Programs that require CAS application
The following programs require you to submit a CAS application instead of a UToledo
application. Select your program to apply through CAS.
Doctor of Pharmacy
Doctor of Physical Therapy
MSBS - Medical Sciences
Nursing (MSN and Certificates only)
For DNP program, please use the UToledo application
Occupational Therapy Doctorate
Physician Assistant
Speech-Language Pathology
